title: Check a number
summary: Express.js: Check a number. Visit /double/cat and read the error.
introduction: A route value needs checks before maths. GET /double/4 returns a doubled whole number.

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install express@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use the stated URL on http://127.0.0.1:3000; stop with Ctrl+C before another example.

blocks.title: Check a number

blocks.text: Number parses the text 4. The integer check passes, and the returned answer is twice 4.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Number() can fail or produce decimals; check the allowed kind of value.
